mia: Hey team — noticed a SCIM bulk provision failure for tenant `acme-corp` right after we pushed the RBAC role rename. KMS decrypt errors in auth-proxy logs. Anyone else seeing this?
security-bot: :rotating_light: alert: service-account-scim-provisioner returned 403 -> KMS_DECRYPT_CONTEXT_MISMATCH for 12 events (see /var/log/provisioner/2023-11-xx.log).
raj: I saw the alert. Quick Q: did the role rename touch the service account extID or the encryption context keys?
mia: We renamed role `acct-admin` -> `customer-admin`. No extID changes, but the deploy included updated RBAC mapping referencing `role.metadata.team`.
olga: If mapping references changed, provisioner might be using a cached KMS context that includes the old role name. KMS context mismatch usually from changes to the JSON used for EncryptContext.
devops: Pasting error block I pulled: ```2023-11-12T08:14:02Z auth-proxy[1123] ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: DecryptContextMismatch: expected context {tenant=acme-corp,extid=svc-scim-123,role=acct-admin}```
mia: That shows blobs encrypted with `role=acct-admin`. New mapping stores `role=customer-admin` so older blobs won't decrypt until rewrapped.
raj: Which job produced the original encrypt? Likely the provisioning backfill from last year.
olga: Found a PR that changed the context shape/ordering: https://git.internal/r/provisioner/PR/987 — the refactor changed serialized keys which breaks deterministic equality. We need to rewrap historical secrets with the new canonical context.
mia: Proposed runbook: 1) Pause SCIM bulk jobs (scale down provisioner) 2) Re-encrypt affected blobs from S3 using script that decrypts with old context and re-encrypts with new context 3) Resume.
devops: I can write rewrap script. Pseudo: `for obj in $(aws s3 ls s3://scim-enc/acme/ --recursive); do aws s3 cp s3://scim-enc/acme/$obj - | decrypt --context role=acct-admin | encrypt --context role=customer-admin | aws s3 cp - s3://scim-enc/acme/$obj; done` Need dry-run first.
raj: Safeguards: 1) run against sample prefix, 2) snapshot bucket (versioning on), 3) allow provisioner to accept old context for short window during cutover.
olga: Update audit entries: rewrap job must write an audit event per object (`object,old_context,new_context,performed_by,timestamp`) — compliance will want that.
mia: Also ensure rewrap principal has kms:Decrypt for old context and kms:Encrypt for new context. @devops please confirm IAM.
devops: Checking `aws iam get-role --role-name scim-rewraper` and will post policy diff. Might need to add condition keys to allow both contexts.
security-bot: Note: If rewrap touches >10K objects, open incident per policy SCIM-CHG-202.
mia: Assignments: @raj coordinate, @devops scripts/permissions, @olga audit/QA. Target: dry-run in 90m, full rewrap in maintenance window tonight.
raj: Opening internal ticket with PR diff + affected tenants list. ETA 60m for dry-run prep.
olga: Drafting audit schema and will attach to ticket. Example event as string: `{"object":"s3://scim-enc/acme/obj.json","old_context":{"role":"acct-admin"},"new_context":{"role":"customer-admin"},"performed_by":"scim-rewraper","timestamp":"2023-11-12T09:00:00Z"}`
mia: If anyone hits blockers post the exact error and object key here. I'll keep channel updated. :thumbsup:
